name: Oriented-Matroid Topes Are Strictly Affine-Oriented-Matroid Topes
scope: Finite simple COMs and their tope graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every oriented-matroid tope graph is an AOM tope graph, and the containment is strict.
proof: Taking a direct sum with the rank-one oriented matroid realizes an OM tope graph as an AOM halfspace. The path $P_3$ is the tope graph of two points on a line, hence AOM, but it is not antipodal and therefore not OM.
